note: Canonical backend deployment authority (BACKEND-AUTHORITY-RECOVERY-05A, 2026-09-08). Reconstituted after Repair 05 exhaustively proved the former canonical branch (rebuild/staging-v2-backend) unrecoverable -- see docs/staging-rebuild/repair05-canonical-authority-reconfirmation-2026-09-08.md and docs/staging-rebuild/backend-authority-v2-provenance-2026-09-08.md. Its initial backend source tree (supabase/functions/**, migrations, manifest) is byte-identical to the release/kscan-pre-freeze-v1 checkout it branched from, itself unchanged from the RP-108-certified governed backend snapshot -- no backend function behavior was altered to create this authority. release/kscan-pre-freeze-v1 remains integration-convergence-non-authoritative and its own deploy tooling continues to refuse deployment; this branch is now the sole checkout that may deploy.

notGoverned.note: Functions deployed on staging that this source tree does not govern.

stagingDiagnosticResidue.reason: RP-108 (2026-09-07): temporary diagnostic slugs left on staging by the 2026-08-30 VTO provider benchmark. They have no source in this tree and never did, so they are not governed here — but they WERE deployed on staging and this file did not name them, which meant a read of it under-counted the live surface by three. Recorded so a fresh clone can account for every slug staging actually carries. vto-provider-diag is documented in docs/vto-provider-benchmark.md §3.7, where it was redeployed as an inert 410 stub; rapidapi-key-diag and rapidapi-current-audit were undocumented anywhere in the repository before this entry.
stagingDiagnosticResidue.posture: vto-provider-diag: verify_jwt=true. rapidapi-key-diag and rapidapi-current-audit: verify_jwt=false, i.e. invokable without a caller JWT. All three were read from the Management API read-only during RP-108; none was invoked, redeployed or deleted by that lane.
stagingDiagnosticResidue.ownerAction: Remove all three slugs from staging (yzqjvdfgefveprobvvyw). This is an owner action: RP-108 has no authority to delete Edge Functions, and the Supabase MCP surface exposes no delete_edge_function tool. They are absent from production.

canonicalBranchNote: GOV-KPLUS-001 CLOSED (2026-09-08, BACKEND-AUTHORITY-RECOVERY-05A). This field is now self-referential -- rebuild/backend-authority-v2 is this branch, published to origin, so a fresh clone resolves it directly (git rev-parse origin/rebuild/backend-authority-v2). History: the original canonical branch, rebuild/staging-v2-backend, was proven unresolvable across an exhaustive search (RP-108, 2026-09-07; Repair 05, 2026-09-08 -- docs/staging-rebuild/repair05-canonical-authority-reconfirmation-2026-09-08.md, which additionally ruled out all 12 branches then self-declaring role=backend-deployment-authority as either already-absorbed or stale). Rather than repair an unrecoverable branch, this branch was created fresh from the certified governed backend snapshot and declared canonical in its place -- see docs/staging-rebuild/backend-authority-v2-provenance-2026-09-08.md. scripts/verify-backend-authority.js verifies this branch resolves and that HEAD descends from it.
governedFunctionCountSource: Must equal GOVERNED_FUNCTIONS.length in scripts/edge-function-manifest-lib.js. Verified by scripts/verify-backend-authority.js; it was 19 against 20 governed functions after commerce-watch-refresh was added and this file was not updated. Was 21 after Build 34 K4 VTO backend convergence added vto-generate (tryon-clothes-pro remains governed as the retired stub). Was 23 (EDGE-02): apple-credential-link and apple-revoke-credential moved out of notGoverned.appleCredentialFunctions into governed status -- their deployed staging/production source lineage was GIT-PROVEN (commit e369fca9) and cross-verified against the live Supabase Management API source on both projects, closing the 'documented but unconfirmed' gap this file previously recorded for them. Now 24 (Repair 06): deletion-status, the post-auth terminal deletion-status capability lookup. Unlike the EDGE-02 pair it is not a recovered deployment but new source governed from birth -- it is deployed nowhere, and is deliberately absent from security/scripts/staging-deployment-allowlist.js so that its first deployment stays a separate, explicit decision.
